verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs say Claude loads a skill automatically when it judges it relevant (docs-2, docs-3, docs-25). The spec requires descriptions to state what a skill does and when to use it (docs-17, docs-32), and skill-creator can optimize a description for triggering accuracy (docs-14). Hands-on reports concretely contradict reliable auto-triggering: users say skills aren't invoked from expected keywords even with proper frontmatter and must be called explicitly (comm-12, comm-13). Cited Vercel evals found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases (comm-14). Missing for 10: independent confirmation that auto-triggering works reliably, and documented guarantees or metrics for activation accuracy.
